responsibility: Defines the internal interfaces, data structures, flags, and inline iterators shared by GCC’s RTL schedulers. It declares scheduler pass IDs, ready-list representation, common/front-end scheduling hooks, logical-UID support, region and block helpers, delay-slot and region-scheduler APIs, and the dependence-list iterator framework used to walk and update sched-deps data. This is the private umbrella header that ties together Haifa, region, EBB, and selective scheduling implementations.
